title: Urodynamic Effects of UK-369,003 in Men With Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms
brief_summary: This is a pilot study to generate hypotheses about the urodynamic effects of UK-369,003 in men with lower urinary tract symptoms.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male subjects, aged 40 years and above, with documented LUTS with an International Prostate Symptom Score (IPSS) ≥13.
* Clinical diagnosis of BPH
* Qmax 5 to 15 ml/sec with a voided volume of ≥150 ml
* Urodynamically defined bladder outlet obstruction

Exclusion Criteria:

* prostate cancer
* Post-void residual urine volume \>200 ml
* Documented UTI
* History of relevant urological surgery
